paras.text: Super-Cram: Michigan Insurance Law, The Numbers
This is the last-hour listen. Every number comes straight from the verified law docs.
Michigan legal system

District court has exclusive civil jurisdiction up to twenty five thousand dollars, M C L six hundred point eighty three oh one. Circuit court is the general trial court, and picks the umpire when appraisers disagree; the Court of Claims only hears claims against the state. The Court of Appeals hears an appeal as of right from a final circuit judgment; the Supreme Court takes a case by leave. A published Court of Appeals opinion binds every lower court, court rule seven point two one five; unpublished, like Tredenick, twenty twenty one, is persuasive only.

Four instruments, descending force: statute, administrative rule, DIFS bulletin, pending bill. Michigan has no matching rule for siding or shingles; rule five hundred point twenty two oh two bans discretionary clauses. DIFS investigates and disciplines licensees; a complaint is leverage and a record, not an order to pay. The ordinary contract statute of limitations is six years, M C L six hundred point fifty eight oh seven, but a fire policy runs its own one year clock, tolled from notice until formal denial.
Policy interpretation

Michigan enforces a policy exactly as written. Rory versus Continental, four seventy three Mich four fifty seven, two thousand five, holds a court cannot refuse an unambiguous term as unreasonable. Wilkie, four sixty nine Mich forty one, two thousand three, killed reasonable expectations outright. Klapp, four sixty eight Mich four fifty nine, two thousand three, says a policy is ambiguous when its provisions are capable of conflicting interpretations; construing it against the insurer is a last resort, after extrinsic evidence fails.

Heniser, four forty nine Mich one fifty five, nineteen ninety five, puts the burden on the insured to show the loss falls inside the policy; Hunt versus Drielick, four ninety six Mich three sixty six, two thousand fourteen, then shifts the burden to the insurer to prove an exclusion, not Heniser for both. Kirschner, four fifty nine Mich five eighty seven, nineteen ninety nine, says waiver and estoppel usually cannot broaden coverage never sold. Sunshine Motors, two oh nine Mich App fifty eight, nineteen ninety five, enforces an anti concurrent causation clause written into an exclusion; Vanguard, four thirty eight Mich four sixty three, nineteen ninety one, is the Supreme Court declining to adopt concurrent causation.

Gavrilides, February first, twenty twenty two, requires something tangible and measurable in, on, or to the premises, and separately enforced the virus exclusion. Every fire policy must pay at least actual cash value, M C L five hundred point twenty eight thirty three, subsection one, subdivision a. Salesin, two twenty nine Mich App three forty six, nineteen ninety eight, puts overhead and profit in an actual cash value payment when a homeowner is reasonably likely to need a general contractor, hired or not. Bulletin twenty twenty four dash twenty six dash I N S requires a standalone, optional, premium reduced endorsement before depreciating labor, taxes, fees, or overhead and profit, personal lines issued or renewed on or after July first, twenty twenty five.
Standard fire policy

M C L five hundred point twenty eight thirty three requires nineteen mandatory provisions, a through s. Subsection a: actual cash value floor. Subsections h and i: the insured cancels anytime, an insurer cancelling mails notice ten days ahead, minimum earned premium is pro rata or twenty five dollars, whichever is greater. Subsection j: if the insured fails to render proof of loss, the mortgagee, on notice, has sixty days to render its own. Subsection m, appraisal: twenty days to name your appraiser, fifteen more to agree an umpire, any two of three sign to set the amount. Subsection p: payable within thirty days of proof of loss amount. Subsection q: suit within one year after the loss, or the policy's period if longer, tolled from notice to formal denial. Subsection s: effective twelve oh one a m.

Two escrow statutes look alike and are not. M C L five hundred point twenty eight forty five covers counties under four hundred twenty five thousand, capping the twenty five percent withholding at twelve thousand dollars from two thousand fifteen, adjusted every January first. M C L five hundred point twenty two twenty seven covers larger counties, or a fifty thousand plus city, adds vandalism, wind, hail, and its base jumped to twenty four thousand on July first, twenty twenty four, adjusted every July first; Bulletin twenty twenty six dash sixteen dash I N S sets it at twenty five thousand ninety for the year beginning July first, twenty twenty six.
Bad faith and unfair trade practices

M C L five hundred point twenty oh six: pay on time or pay twelve percent interest. Subsection three gives the insurer thirty days after receiving a claim to specify what a satisfactory proof of loss needs; a partial claim is timely if paid within sixty days of that partial proof. Subsection four starts twelve percent simple interest sixty days after satisfactory proof of loss, for the insured or anyone directly entitled to benefits; the reasonably in dispute defense lives only in the second sentence, for third party tort claimants.

M C L five hundred point twenty twenty six lists fourteen unfair practices DIFS can punish, only as a course of conduct showing a persistent tendency, never an isolated incident, and no private lawsuit lies under it. The fines sit two sections later, in twenty thirty eight: up to one thousand per violation, ten thousand aggregate, or five thousand per violation and fifty thousand aggregate for knowing violations in a six month period. Twenty forty adds twenty thousand per violation for defying a cease and desist order. Young, one thirty nine Mich App six hundred, nineteen eighty four, confirms the insured can privately sue to recover the twenty oh six interest penalty, just not a tort claim built on either section.

Kewin, four oh nine Mich four oh one, nineteen eighty, killed first party bad faith as its own tort, leaving only contract benefits. Commercial Union, four twenty six Mich one twenty seven, nineteen eighty six, is where bad faith survives: a liability insurer's duty to settle within limits, arbitrary, reckless, indifferent, or intentional disregard. Griswold, two seventy six Mich App five fifty one, two thousand seven, and Nickola, five hundred Mich one fifteen, two thousand seventeen, confirm the twelve percent belongs to a first party insured regardless of dispute. Smith versus Globe Life, four sixty Mich four forty six, nineteen ninety nine, let that claim proceed then; today M C L four forty five point nine oh four, subsection three, bars it for conduct on or after March twenty eighth, two thousand one. Senate Bill two forty five is still pending, not law.
Appraisal and suit limits

Appraisal decides how much is owed, never whether it is owed, Kwaiser, one ninety Mich App four eighty two, nineteen ninety one. The twenty day clock runs from receipt of the written demand, the fifteen day clock from the appraisers' failure to agree, neither from the date of loss. Cantina, three forty nine Mich App six eighty two, twenty twenty four, held that paying part of a claim without formally denying is an admission opening the whole thing to appraisal. Maksym, February twenty fourth, twenty twenty six, narrowed that: paying items you agree are covered while expressly denying others is not a partial payment, denied items stay out of appraisal until coverage is resolved.

White, two ninety three Mich App four nineteen, twenty eleven, allows a contingency fee appraiser if the carrier is told; a party appraiser need only be independent, not the umpire's tougher impartial standard. Dupree, four ninety seven Mich one, twenty fourteen, confirms an award reopens only for bad faith, fraud, misconduct, or manifest mistake; replacement cost still needs proof repairs were completed. Tolling from notice to formal denial comes from Tom Thomas, three ninety six Mich five eighty eight, nineteen seventy six. Smitham, two ninety seven Mich App five thirty seven, twenty twelve, says a formal denial must be explicit and unequivocal, a policy cannot condition tolling on it, void under M C L five hundred point twenty eight sixty, and a partial payment alone does not restart the clock.
Adjuster and public adjuster licensing

M C L five hundred point twelve twenty two requires a license to adjust, advertise, or hold yourself out as an adjuster; subsection two lists exactly five exemptions, an attorney, a marine average adjuster, an insurer's employee, a producer with granted claim authority, and a narrow supervised data entry role, no contractor exemption. M C L five hundred point twelve twenty four, subsection four, is a categorical bar: no adjuster license to anyone employed by, owning stock in, an officer or director of, or connected in any manner with a fire repair contractor.

M C L five hundred point twelve twenty six, subsection three, caps a public adjuster's fee at ten percent of what the insurer pays in settlement. Subsection four requires a DIFS approved contract form before services begin; a contract signed within forty eight hours of the loss is voidable for ten days. Summary suspension, if the licensee asks for a hearing, gets one not later than twenty days, a decision within thirty more. Under twelve forty four, fines run to one thousand per violation, or five thousand if knowing, hard capped at fifty thousand per order; defying a cease and desist order runs to twenty thousand per violation, capped at one hundred thousand.

Tredenick, unpublished, twenty twenty one, denied a public adjuster on an eight percent contract both the fee and a fallback quantum meruit payment, for using a contract form DIFS never approved, missing the mandatory forty eight hour voidability clause. DIFS revoked Guldshtadt's license April first, twenty twenty six, and fined him fifty thousand dollars, for contracts charging thirty five percent, roughly triple the cap, and a connection to a fire repair contractor.
Claims clocks and DIFS

The Michigan claim calendar, in order: thirty days from receipt of the claim for the insurer to specify what a satisfactory proof of loss needs. Thirty days from proof of the amount of loss for payment to be due. Sixty days from satisfactory proof of loss before twelve percent interest starts. Ten days' mailed notice to cancel a fire policy mid term. One year, tolled from notice to formal denial, to sue.

The Essential Insurance Act adds a longer layer: termination for anything but nonpayment needs thirty days' written notice, or twenty within the policy's first fifty five days, matching the insurer's filed rules. A carrier can nonrenew on claim history: three paid claims in the preceding three years. The statute still prints three thousand excluding weather related claims and four thousand including them, but Bulletin twenty twenty four dash oh two dash I N S certified new minimums as of January first, two thousand twenty four: five thousand exclusive of weather related claims, six thousand six hundred including them. Fannie Mae's initial release is the greater of forty thousand or thirty three percent of proceeds, only twenty five percent if delinquent thirty one plus days, capped at ten thousand.
Contractors, liens, and assignment of benefits

An unlicensed builder cannot sue for payment or record a lien, M C L three thirty nine point twenty four twelve. Epps, four ninety eight Mich five eighteen, twenty fifteen, held a contract with an unlicensed builder voidable, not void, and only for an innocent homeowner; the statute is a shield, not a sword to claw back money paid. Home lien rights need a written contract with the license number, no dollar floor, M C L five seventy point eleven fourteen. A subcontractor or supplier serves notice of furnishing within twenty days, a laborer thirty, a direct contractor neither. Record the lien within ninety days of last furnishing, foreclose within one year.

Post loss assignment of an already accrued claim needs no carrier consent, from Roger Williams versus Carrington in eighteen eighty, restated in Shah, three twenty four Mich App one eighty two, twenty eighteen. No published Michigan property case gives an assignee contractor the twelve percent as its own right; at best it is enforced derivatively. Small claims tops out at seven thousand dollars, neither side gets a lawyer unless removed first. The home improvement financing act gives one business day, to five p m, for installment contracts over three hundred dollars; the solicitation act gives three business days, to midnight, for anything solicited at the door.
Essential Insurance Act and market

Chapter twenty one, the Essential Insurance Act, added nineteen seventy nine. M C L five hundred point twenty one seventeen is the must offer, must renew rule: an insurer cannot refuse or limit home insurance except on ten listed grounds, physical condition tied to a real code standard, claim history at renewal, vacancy over sixty days, a changed adjacent hazard, never traffic patterns. Every underwriting rule must be written, filed, and applied uniformly.

Termination covers cancellation and nonrenewal under one definition, on the thirty and twenty day notice rules above. Redlining is banned outright, M C L five hundred point twenty one oh eight. Chapter twenty nine creates the FAIR plan: every insurer must belong and serve every qualified applicant, insurance to value floors of eighty percent of replacement cost on a replacement cost policy, one hundred percent of market value on a repair cost policy. The pool's fraud disqualifier needs a denied claim over two thousand dollars that also exceeds fifteen percent of coverage in force under a repair cost policy, or ten percent under a replacement cost policy, a test the voluntary market does not carry.
Bar exam and legal foundations

Rule one, subsection C requires sixty semester hours or ninety quarter hours before starting law school, not a finished bachelor's degree. Rule two, subsection B treats an American Bar Association approved law degree as automatically reputable and qualified; anything else needs a discretionary board waiver. The bar exam is the Uniform Bar Exam: multistate bar exam fifty percent, essay thirty percent, two performance test items twenty percent, on a four hundred point scale. Michigan's passing score is two hundred sixty eight, valid for three years once achieved; its professional responsibility score is eighty five, with no Michigan time limit on when that exam was taken. A score transfers in from another jurisdiction only if earned within the three years immediately preceding. Michigan moves to the next generation exam starting July twenty twenty eight; February twenty twenty eight is the last legacy exam.

No standalone insurance law subject exists, it lives inside contracts, torts, and evidence. Michigan recites five contract elements, not the national four: competent parties, proper subject matter, legal consideration, mutuality of agreement, mutuality of obligation, Hess, two sixty five Mich App five eighty two, two thousand five. Parol evidence cannot contradict a clear written contract. A condition precedent is a fact the parties intend must happen before a right to performance exists, Harbor Park Market, two seventy seven Mich App one twenty six, two thousand seven; a missed proof of loss deadline bars recovery regardless of prejudice, absent waiver or estoppel. Kewin ties expectation damages to Hadley versus Baxendale: recovery caps at policy value, no emotional distress. Titan versus Hyten, four ninety one Mich five forty seven, twenty twelve, lists six fraud elements, no duty to investigate. Kandil Elsayed, five twelve Mich ninety five, twenty twenty three, restates negligence as duty, breach, causation, harm, moving open and obvious into breach and comparative fault. Tort statute of limitations three years, contract six.
The traps

M C L five hundred point twelve twenty one does not exist; the adjuster prohibition is twelve twenty two. Klapp is four sixty eight Mich four fifty nine, not four sixteen. Kwaiser is one ninety Mich App four eighty two, not page four. Kewin's famous phrase, wholly separate and independent, appears nowhere in the opinion; the real holding declines to make bad faith breach an independent and separately actionable tort.

Cantina never meant any partial payment opens a whole claim to appraisal, Maksym narrowed that hard. Tom Thomas never held a one year suit limit unreasonable, it rested only on tolling, and Rory overruled only its reasonableness dicta, not the tolling holding. Guldshtadt's license ended revoked, not merely suspended, and DIFS charged him under subsection three of twelve twenty four plus subsection two of twelve forty two, not the categorical subsection four bar. And the statute's three thousand and four thousand nonrenewal dollars are superseded by the bulletin certified five thousand and six thousand six hundred.
Say the right Michigan number, know which case said it, and walk in ready.
